items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Fud Livingston got a fantastic offer from a fellow by the name of Nat Shilkret, Nap Shokert, who was a big figure with Victor Records, fine musician, and Fud was to arrange to come to New York and freelance and I don't know that he was going to play, I think he was going to write.

ctx.x: Fud Livingston got a fantastic offer from a fellow by the name of Nat Shilkret, Nap Shokert, who was a big figure with Victor Records, fine musician, and Fud was to arrange to come to New York and freelance and I don't know that he was going to play, I think he was going to write.
